cells: All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam ADMK

prose: In the 2006 election to the 140-seat Kerala Legislative Assembly, the Left Democratic Front (LDF) emerged largest with 94 seats, against 46 for the UDF. Turnout was 72.38% of 21,484,486 electors.
By vote share, the LDF polled 51.63% and the UDF 39.44%, with the NDA on 4.75%. A total of 931 candidates contested the 140 seats.
Compared with 2001, the LDF gained 54 seats (from 40 to 94); the UDF moved from 99 to 46. Power changed hands from the UDF.
The closest contest was Nedumangad, won by MANKODE RADHAKRISHNAN (CPI) over PALODE RAVI (INCI) by just 85 votes. The largest margin was M. CHANDHRAN in Alathur (47,671 votes).
V. S. Achuthanandan headed the Council of Ministers that followed.
